design_fields.q1_rationale: The editorial does not analyze student achievement outcomes from ILSA instruments and therefore does not generate or model plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The editorial does not conduct a new empirical analysis of ILSA microdata, so there are no student-level sampling weights applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit.
design_fields.q4_rationale: There is no mention of any validation strategy in the editorial.
